text:
claire: Heads up — rolled back the permsync PR in prod. Some audit events for role updates are missing in the last ~90m. Compliance report due EOD, @compliance any requirements on fields we must include? :warning:
omar: On it. Do we know which API path was used? `iam.v2/roles.update` or the legacy `iam/patch`?
claire: Looks like the new iam.v2 endpoint. Rolled back because UI showed users losing `dedicated-admin` role.
raj: Pulled app logs, audit_trail rows exist but actor=null for those request_ids. Suspect the service principal didn't set X-Actor header after the refactor.
emily: We saw something similar when service-to-service auth rotated keys; token introspection sometimes yields only client_id. KMS key rotation happened ~45m before the first missing event.
sec-bot: Incident bot: created incident INC-2025-2643. Triage assigned to @omar @raj.
omar: I can repro locally: POST /v2/roles with a service JWT returns sub=service-xyz instead of user id. Looks like the middleware mapping client_id->actor_name didn't run after the middleware ordering change.
claire: Quick Q — is this only an audit display problem or are ACL checks broken?
raj: ACL checks are OK — permissions applied as expected. Main risk is compliance: missing actor breaks who-did-what reporting. We need a patch + retroactive backfill.
emily: Backfill plan: correlate request_ids in app_logs then derive actor from svc_map (service token -> owner mapping). svc_map fields are encrypted; we'll need KMS decrypt permission to read service metadata.
compliance-bot: @claire For the EOD report we require these columns: actor, action, target_resource, timestamp, request_id. If actor cannot be recovered, we need to flag those rows and include mitigation.
omar: Plan: add middleware guard that 1) enforces X-Actor when JWT contains user sub, 2) maps client_id->service_account for service tokens. I'll push a canary and instrument audit events (include request_id).
claire: Also add a small repair script to tag ambiguous events with `actor: unknown_service` and export the request_ids for compliance.
raj: Draft SQL for the backfill (needs KMS-decrypt for svc_map):
```sql
UPDATE audit_trail
SET actor = svc_map.actor_name
FROM (
  SELECT request_id, MAX(actor_name) as actor_name
  FROM app_logs JOIN svc_map USING (client_id)
  WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '3 hours'
  GROUP BY request_id
) svc_map
WHERE audit_trail.request_id = svc_map.request_id
AND audit_trail.actor IS NULL;
```
emily: Grant request filed to KMS: `kms-ops@` -> decrypt `svc_map.master_key`. PR #482 created for time-limited decrypt role.
claire: OK. Omar/raj/emily — prioritize the patch + backfill. I'll update compliance template to add root cause + list of repaired request_ids. Will schedule a short postmortem tomorrow.
sec-bot: Incident bot: update INC-2025-2643 status -> investigating. :eyes:
